description.narrative:
2 OBJECTIVES OF THE PROJECT 2.1 The expected results of the Project supported under the call for proposals are as follows:
The Project’s Expected Effect(s) on Society The Project will drive Ukraine’s post-war green recovery by developing a 170 MW wind farm in Kirovohrad region, delivering 0.52 TWh of clean energy annually, cutting emissions, attracting over €200 million in investment, and creating jobs. It will boost local revenues, improve power reliability for industry, and strengthen energy security while serving as a model for future renewable projects. The Project’s Expect ed Effect(s) for the Target Group Local communities will gain jobs and income, industrial users will have more reliable electricity, investors will have a secure project, and authorities, contractors, and grid operators will benefit from new opportunities, improved stability, and valuable experience for future projects.
Planned Main Outputs in This Phase - Legal securing of land for the wind farm and infrastructure. - Confirmation of grid connection and completion of technical grid studies. - Completion of all necessary permits, licenses, and zoning approvals. - Establishment of formal cooperation with local municipalities. - Creation and operationalization of a dedicated Ukrainian project company (SPV). - Completion of the Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA). - Preparation of the engineering and design package. - Completion of wind measurement and energy yield assessments. - Execution of all required technical, legal, and feasibility studies. - Launch of the tender process for Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) contracts, and preparation of full due diligence documentation.
